dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity indicates a uniform light-to-medium grey skin tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey mottled patches distributed across the dorsal surface, more concentrated toward the posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the darker pigmented mottling and the lighter grey baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of small, high-contrast dark circular marks and faint linear streaks across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks on the lateral-dorsal surfaces and scattered small dark epidermal spots.
